fact: Jembi states that in July 2024 Mozambique launched real-time digital birth registration connecting the hospital system MGDH-Birth to the civil registration system e-SiRCEV through its OpenHIM interoperability layer, as a pilot that grew from 5 to 19 health facilities in Inhambane Province and registered over 11,589 newborns.

C-Saude reports that the laboratory information system DISA sends viral load results automatically to the patient tracking system SESP, covering all provinces with more than 500 facilities and over a million results transmitted in the past 12 months.

Jembi reports that interoperability between the civil registration system e-SiRCEV and the hospital births module MGDH-births launched on 22 July 2024, after an Inhambane Province start in April and May 2024 that takes birth-registering facilities there from five to nineteen, with nationwide expansion planned.
